name: Christchurch
blurb: Start and finish. Airport pickup and drop.

name: Lake Tekapo
blurb: Church of the Good Shepherd and the bluest water on the route.

name: Lake Pukaki
blurb: Coffee and photo stop with Aoraki at the end of the lake.

name: Wanaka
blurb: Lakefront town. That Wanaka Tree is 10min walk from the centre.

name: Cromwell
blurb: Start of the Lake Dunstan Trail. E-bike hire and shuttles here.

name: Clyde
blurb: End of the Lake Dunstan Trail. Historic main street and a good pub.

name: Queenstown
blurb: Two nights. Gondola and the Earnslaw for the free day.

name: Gibbston Valley
blurb: Cellar doors 25min out of Queenstown.

name: Te Anau
blurb: Gateway to Fiordland. Quiet lakefront.

name: Manapouri
blurb: Doubtful Sound cruises leave from Pearl Harbour here.

name: Doubtful Sound
blurb: Three hours of silence on the fiord, reached by boat and bus over Wilmot Pass.

name: Haast Pass
blurb: Blue Pools and Thunder Creek Falls on the way over.

name: Franz Josef
photo: View into valley of Franz Josef Glacier in spring.jpg | Franz Josef Glacier, South Island.jpg
blurb: Glacier viewpoint is a 30min stroll from the car park.

name: Hokitika
blurb: Driftwood sign on the beach and pounamu carvers.

name: Punakaiki
blurb: Pancake Rocks and the Truman Track.

name: Pororari River Track
blurb: Nikau palms and limestone cliffs along a slow green river. The forest walk at Punakaiki.

name: Westport
blurb: Fuel and a break before the Buller Gorge.

name: Wakefield
blurb: The pie stop. Wakefield Bakery on SH6.

name: Nelson
blurb: Two nights. Start of the Great Taste Trail.

name: Mapua
blurb: End of the Great Taste Trail ride. Ferry and wharf lunch.

name: Kaiteriteri
blurb: Golden sand beach and water taxis into Abel Tasman.

name: Renwick
blurb: Airbnb among the vines. Cellar doors within walking distance.

name: Kaikoura
blurb: Crayfish at Nin's Bin and seals at Point Kean.
